featured_reviews.review_text:
overall not happy with the experience

called them for consultation to repaint the entire house
their quote was higher by 30 % of the market rate
but still went ahead with their service expecting to get a premium experience
initially they assigned 2 people for the actual paint job and an onsite manager to oversee the progress
of the 2 folks from the team assigned to do the painting job one kept changing everyday - only one of them was fixed till end of project
with females in the house it's not safe to see new strangers entering your house everyday
the onsite manager would visit every alternate day and complete inspection in only 10min
many times didn't get proper consultation from onsite manager on several issues
infact got more ideas from the pre sales manager on what would work best in the current setup considering the furniture
was told that paint would last easily for 5 years but in 2 months itself it started coming off from few places
(see attached pics)
have raised this issue with them several times and everytime got false assurances that they will fix it
it's been more than 4  months now and they have not taken any action to resolve
hope my experience will help others in taking the right call for their painting needs
